import json, subprocess, sys, time
def bench(req, label):
    raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
    el=time.time()-t
    out=p.stdout.decode()
    print(label,'rc',p.returncode,'%.2fs'%el,'outbytes',len(out), ('INVALID' if 'error' in out else ''), p.stderr.decode()[:300])
    return out
def tr(count,width,**kw):
    return dict(op='train',p=0,count=count,width=width,ranks=[0,1,2,3],**kw)
for count,width in [(250000,64),(250000,250000)]:
    bench({'cases':[{'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':count,'words':1,'capacity':64,'start':0,
      'events':[tr(count,width)]}]}, 'ar-mode3 N=64 count=%d width=%d'%(count,width))
bench({'cases':[{'primitive':'allreduce','mode':2,'root':0,'segments':100000,'words':1,'capacity':32,'start':0,
      'events':[tr(100000,32),{'op':'ack','rank':0,'upto':100000},{'op':'ack','rank':1,'upto':100000},{'op':'ack','rank':2,'upto':100000},{'op':'ack','rank':3,'upto':100000}]}]}, 'ar-mode2')
bench({'cases':[{'primitive':'allgather','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':32768,'words':8,'capacity':32,'start':0,
      'events':[tr(32768,32)]}]}, 'gather mode3')
bench({'cases':[{'primitive':'broadcast','mode':3,'root':1,'segments':250000,'words':1,'capacity':16,'start':0,
      'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':250000,'width':16,'ranks':[0,1,2,3]}]}]}, 'bcast')
bench({'cases':[{'primitive':'reducescatter','mode':3,'root':1,'segments':131072,'words':4,'capacity':64,'start':0,
      'events':[tr(131072,64)]}]}, 'scatter')
# many snaps: N=4096, D=1, 32 snaps
ev=[tr(4000,4000)]+[dict(op='snap',tag='s%d'%i) for i in range(20)]
bench({'cases':[{'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':4000,'words':1,'capacity':4096,'start':0,'events':ev}]}, 'snaps')
